title: Calling the Operator from Behind Bars: Norfolk's City Jail Librarian Who Overcame Odds - NewsBreak
text:
11 hours ago There was a time before cellphones, when you could pick up a landline, dial 0, and a well-informed woman would provide assistance with any call you needed to make. For Paterson, New Jersey native Derrick Hansford, it proved quite a personal experience. He says, “I used to be able to go and hit the 0, the operator button on the phone, on a payphone or anything, and just automatically get my grandmother.” His grandmother worked as a telephone operator for the Bell Atlantic telephone company.
